interface.shortDescription: A multi-agent brand production team for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Team Durham packages a complete design-team harness for brand production: Kotler, Aaker, Glaser, Ogilvy, Rand, Munari, Tufte, seven named agents with folded evidence and governance responsibilities, shared skills, orchestration commands, governance rules, and persona research. Use it to take client briefs through strategy, naming, visual direction, brand kit assembly, QA, memory, and delivery.
defaultPrompt: Activate Kotler for a new brand brief.
Run Team Durham status for this client.
